name: myssagent-for-financial-advisors
description: MySSAgent is a Social Security claiming analysis platform for financial advisors. It reads each client's actual earnings record and calculates claiming options to the month, including spousal and survivor benefits, following the Social Security Administration's published rules, including the Program Operations Manual System (POMS). This plugin brings that analysis into Claude: meeting-prep briefs, survivor checks and client-ready drafts, with every figure taken from the MySSAgent engine.
